title: Integrate with the ellmer ecosystem
text: Graft built around four small, composable primitives exposed S7 values: Artifacts (ArtifactRef, Artifact): Immutable bytes identified logical id content-addressed revision (SHA-256 canonical metadata plus payload digest). Saving updated content id creates new revision without overwriting earlier one. Selections (ArtifactSelection): Explicit root references together complete verified dependency closure. Reading selection re-verifies every referenced artifact digest. graft_read() reads exact historical artifact reference. graft_recall() checks current host eligibility, purpose match, stream’s current accepted head, intact selected bytes. graft_streams() graft_history() inspect decisions without loading artifact payloads. Vocabulary releases (VocabularyRelease): Immutable selections bundling shared concepts, relationships, qualified data-dict bindings, source bytes, generated Markdown context readers need publishing CLI.

title: Integrate with the ellmer ecosystem
text: abstract ArtifactStore S7 class two built-implementations: LocalArtifactStore (graft_store()): Stores content-addressed objects append-decision journals local directory. Several R processes can safely write one store file system honors advisory file locks—content writes atomic staged renames decisions take per-stream file lock. PostgresArtifactStore (graft_store_postgres()): Stores exact bytes digests graft_artifact_objects inside DBI transaction owned application, isolated host-selected scope key serialized transaction-scoped advisory lock. Neither store serializes live connections, ellmer chats, R environments. Every object plain canonical JSON raw bytes, verified read.

Saving bytes never approves reuse. Local stores isolate multiple users inside one directory: multi-user isolation disk requires separate store directories per user enforced file system host application. ArtifactRef pairs logical identity (@id) exact immutable revision (@revision). mutable “latest” pointer: keep references workflow depends , record decision stream application wants reviewed current result. code: library(graft)  store <- graft_store("project-memory", create = TRUE)  # In your app's review button handler: source_ref <- graft_save(   store, "Handbook: 30-day paid activity window.", "metrics.md" ) note_ref <- graft_save(   store, "Active customers have paid activity in the past 30 days.",   id = "metric:active-customer", dependencies = source_ref ) graft_accept(   store, note_ref, stream = "metric:active-customer", expected = NULL,   key = "review-1", actor = current_user, reason = "Verified", purpose = "chat" )  # In each Shiny session's ellmer chat: chat <- ellmer::chat_openai() chat$set_tools(graft_tools(   store,   purpose = "chat",   eligible = function(stream) user_can_read(current_user, stream) )) memory_tools <- graft_tools(   store,   purpose = "project-assistance",   eligible = function(stream) TRUE )  agent <- deputy::Agent$new(   chat = ellmer::chat_openai(),   tools = c(memory_tools, list(draft_tool)),   trusted_results = deputy::TrustedResults(     definition = "draft_definition",     on_result = function(event) {       # Saved as an unaccepted draft; never recalled until graft_accept()       graft_save(store, event$value, id = "draft:metric:active-customer")     }   ) ) library(graft)  store <- graft_store("/absolute/path/to/project-memory") tools <- graft_tools(   store,   purpose = "project-assistance",   eligible = function(stream) TRUE )  mcptools::mcp_server(tools = tools, session_tools = FALSE) verify_ragnar_hit <- function(store, hit_stream, purpose, eligible) {   recalled <- graft_recall(     store,     stream = hit_stream,     purpose = purpose,     eligible = eligible(hit_stream)   )   if (!identical(recalled@status, "accepted")) return(NULL)   recalled } investigation_ref <- graft_save_file(   store, "scans-investigation.json",   id = "scans:investigation:2026-11-26", media_type = "application/json" ) note_ref <- graft_save(   store, "Count paid accounts active in the past 30 days.",   id = "metric:active-customer", dependencies = investigation_ref ) graft_accept(   store, note_ref, stream = "metric:active-customer", expected = NULL,   key = "promote-1", actor = "reviewer",   reason = "Promoted recurring untrusted route from scans", purpose = "chat" )
